en: The image shows an old monochrome postcard with a photograph of a grand Gothic-style cathedral with two tall spires, rising above traditional rooftops and round defensive towers. The postcard features handwritten script across its surface. The printed text on the top left reads 'Zagreb (Croatie)' and on the right 'Prvostolna crkva – La Cathédrale'. The date '6.6.1904.' is handwritten in the lower right corner.
